name: Mitch Raposo
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: A 28-year-old American flyweight (11-3; 2-2 UFC; Regiment Training Center) who has won two straight decisions after starting 0-2 in the UFC on split losses. Fast-handed and mobile, with good takedown defense and the ability to get back up. All four of his UFC fights went the distance, and three were split decisions.

how_they_fight.Striking: Fast starter on the feet: jab, quick combinations and a left hook that cut Nascimento in R1. Moves a lot to avoid power, and can switch to standing in the pocket and timing exchanges (Cageside, on Nascimento R2). Says he wants to 'throw hands', not wrestle. Low volume overall (about 2.8 significant strikes a minute).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defensive and scrambly. Stuffed takedowns with uppercuts against Nascimento (four stopped in our data). Maksum landed 7 of 19 and controlled him for over five minutes, but Raposo kept standing up and threatened an omoplata and a guillotine. Three career submissions, all regional.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never knocked out. Jake Hadley submitted him in R2 on the 2021 Contender Series. Both UFC losses were split decisions (Andre Lima, Su Mudaerji). He was dropped by Nascimento in R3 and survived under ground strikes by tying him up.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Wins early rounds, gets tested late. Against Nascimento he won R1 and R2 and lost R3 after a knockdown; Maksum's wrestling took over in R3 too. Stoppage wins: four in R1, one in R2, one in R3, one in R4 of a five-rounder (2024 regional title fight). He hasn't finished anyone in the UFC.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Fight-to-fight improvement, and he has talked openly about pre-fight nerves ('demons') before his first UFC win. Tends to leave close fights with the judges.

patterns: Takes R1 with speed and movement
Strong takedown defense and gets back up
All four UFC fights went the distance; three split decisions
Has been hurt or out-grappled in R3 (Nascimento, Maksum)
concerns: Late-fight dips: dropped in R3 by Nascimento
Low output against a busy finisher
Pulled out of the April Nascimento date with a virus
keys_to_beat: Survive his R1 speed and come on late
Pressure him into the fence and go to the body
Mix in takedowns late to steal R3

news.text: Beat Allan Nascimento by split decision (29-28, 29-28, 28-29) after being dropped in R3.
Pulled out of the original April date at UFC Winnipeg with a virus; the fight moved to June.
Nascimento, his last opponent, died in August at age 34 after an apparent heart attack in his sleep.
Booked against Contender Series signee Marcos Degli (first reported by Ag Fight, per MMA Sucka).
